title: Clubsss
tagline: Create web3 powered communities and hold exclusive discussions
description: The most crucial part of clubsss is its factory contract deployed on Polygon which generates club contracts. These club contracts control who can access the club, can share posts and also the weight of votes of each member. With the help of IPFS, we are hosting the content in a decentralized manner. So, clubsss doesn't own any data, real people own their data.
